title: LRT Detector
text: 似然比检验检测器，输入 3 路、输出 3 路；{Probability of false alarm} 指定虚警概率、{Output format} 输出数据的格式 Detection、{Output detection statistics and threshold} 输出检测统计量和阈值、{Simulate using} 指定模块仿真方法 Interpreted，按实例取值。

ports.name: X
ports.summary: 输入数据 real-valued N -by- 1 vector | complex-valued N -by- 1 vector | real-valued N -by- M matrix | complex-valued N -by- M matrix

ports.name: XK
ports.summary: 已知信号 real-valued N -by-1 vector | complex-valued N -by-1 vector

ports.name: Y
ports.summary: 检测结果 1-by- M logical-valued vector | 1-by- L integer-valued vector

ports.name: Stat
ports.summary: 检测统计量 D -by- M (default) | matrix | 1-by- L vector
